summary: CardSquare search coverage and product URL generation are fixed. The provider now queries a CardSquare-biased term and rewrites CardSquare SmartStore product links to the observed live slug, sulyunyen.
rootCause: General Naver Shopping queries often return CardKingdom preferred results but omit CardSquare from the first page.
CardSquare products were incorrectly rewritten to /yugiohstore/products/{id}. Naver's own /main/products/{id} redirect for the reproduced product points to /sulyunyen/products/{id}.
evidence: Live API spot check for 도마우스 returned CardKingdom 1 and CardSquare 2
Live API spot check for 블랙 매지션 returned CardKingdom 10 and CardSquare 41
knownLimitations: Naver SmartStore can still apply browser/session security, login, or 429 behavior outside the app's control.
Broad terms can now surface many CardSquare variants because the app intentionally includes a CardSquare-specific query.
